import bpy,json,collections
from mathutils import Vector
c=bpy.data.collections['Shipyard_COMBINED_Craft'];r=[]
for o in c.objects:
 if o.type!='MESH' or not o.data.materials:continue
 if not any(t in o.data.materials[0].name for t in ['Limestone','Coping','Mortar','M14_']):continue
 ps=[o.matrix_world@Vector(v) for v in o.bound_box];lo=[min(p[i] for p in ps) for i in range(3)];hi=[max(p[i] for p in ps) for i in range(3)]
 if lo[0]<-3.8 and 1.8<hi[2]<3.3:r.append({'name':o.name,'min':lo,'max':hi,'vertices':len(o.data.vertices),'mat':o.data.materials[0].name})
print(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False))
